Best Solar PV Companies in Johor Bahru, Malaysia

If you're looking for a reliable solar photovoltaic (PV) installer in Johor Bahru, I would prioritise companies with proven installation experience, SEDA Malaysia registration where applicable, good after-sales support, and experience with both residential and commercial systems.

The best choice also depends on whether you're installing solar panels on a house, factory, warehouse, or commercial building. A strong industrial solar contractor isn't necessarily the best choice for a small residential rooftop.

My recommended shortlist (November 2026)

Based on current business listings, customer feedback, services and solar-industry directories, these are the seven companies I would shortlist first. This is a practical recommendation, not an independently audited quality ranking.
